n44b597f5fa.headline: The recovery started but inflation resists giving ground
n44b597f5fa.summary: Argentina ended its recession in 2017, but inflation remains resistant to decline, alongside rising Lebac rates.
n44b597f5fa.why: Persistent inflation and central bank policies affect economic stability, investment climate, and currency valuation.
n44b597f5fa.why_moved: The persistence of inflation despite economic recovery and rising Lebac rates signals ongoing monetary tightening, impacting bond yields and investor sentiment.
